en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small wooden church building with a metal roof topped by simple crosses, surrounded by a picket fence. Behind the church stands a separate wooden belfry or bell tower among trees. The upper border carries the handwritten word "Uppland." At the bottom, a label identifies the place as "Björkö-Arholma, Upl." The overall style suggests an early‑20th‑century Scandinavian rural church scene.
